en: A black-and-white photograph featuring a group of people posing outdoors on a cobblestone path. The group includes women in traditional folk dress (headscarves and long skirts), a man in a suit, a child, and other individuals. The setting is leafy, with mature trees and what appears to be a rural or village background. There is no visible text on the front of the postcard.
